body:
## Quick answer

Yes, you can order a **custom stitched salwar kameez online**: at Bahe Kurtiz every kurta set, suit and Anarkali can be **stitched to your measurements at no extra cost**, up to size 3XL (4XL in our linen & velvet styles). Choose the style, send your bust, waist, hip and height (plus any length you prefer), and our own unit in Jaipur stitches it in 5–7 working days before shipping worldwide.

## Ready size or custom fit?

| | Ready size | Custom fit |
|---|---|---|
| Sizes | XS–3XL (4XL in linen & velvet) | Your measurements, up to 3XL (4XL in linen & velvet) |
| Extra cost | – | None |
| Dispatch | 2–4 working days | 5–7 working days |
| Best if | You are a standard size | You are between sizes, tall, petite or plus size |

## Why made-to-measure?

Ready-made Indian outfits are cut for standard Indian sizes. For many women abroad, that means a tight bust, loose waist or the wrong length – and a trip to the tailor. With Bahe Kurtiz, your piece is stitched to your body from the start.

## How it works

1. Choose any style and your closest size
2. Share your bust, waist, hip and height (and length preference) on WhatsApp or at checkout
3. We stitch your piece in our Jaipur unit and send you photos before it ships
4. It arrives at your door, ready to wear

## How to measure yourself

- **Bust:** around the fullest part, tape level
- **Waist:** around your natural waist
- **Hip:** around the fullest part of your hips
- **Height:** without shoes

## Shipping, fit and returns

- **Free worldwide shipping** to the USA, UK, Canada, UAE and Australia, with tracking
- Ready sizes ship in 2–4 working days; made-to-measure pieces take 5–7 working days, then 5–10 business days for delivery
- **Free custom fit** – send your bust, waist, hip and height and we stitch it for you
- We send you photos of your piece before it ships
- Import duties and taxes included – nothing to pay on delivery

Need help measuring? [WhatsApp us](https://wa.me/917073350886) – we will guide you step by step.

faq.q: Which measurements do I need for a custom salwar kameez?
faq.a: Bust, waist, hip and height – plus kurta and pant length if you have a preference. Our guide shows how to measure yourself in a few minutes.

faq.q: Is there an extra charge for custom stitching?
faq.a: No. Custom fit is free on our styles.

faq.q: What if the fit is not right?
faq.a: If we stitched it wrong to your measurements, we remake it free. If your measurements were a little off, we offer one free alteration (up to a $10 local tailor credit).
